3.4-11.rationale: DEFERRED_HARDENING. Store.Stats walks ~1M records under the mutex the BMP receive goroutines need; the ~22 ms figure was confirmed real. Deferred because there is no correctness defect and NO TEST THAT CAN FAIL on the current code — it is purely a lock-hold property. Blast radius: the ring is per-session and drop-oldest, so the pause costs something only if a peer bursts >4096 updates inside a <=22 ms window, and that case is COUNTED (UpdatesDropped), not silent. The numbers need a large BMP deployment; the single-box target runs one or two sessions where the walk is microseconds. The one place a correctness bug could hide — the OldestUpdateSeq==0 sentinel — was checked and is safe, since s.seq++ precedes Seq: s.seq so no record carries sequence 0. The O(1) fix is obvious, but applying an unprovable optimisation to the hot lock path of a receive loop is the change not to make blind.
